# Capability Pack Manager

This candidate defines the Core boundary only. It does not install, update, or
publish Mall packs before G-01 and the ADR-008 amendment are approved.

## Allowed Work

1. Explain current Mall metadata and trust evidence.
2. Produce a dry-run plan for a future pack transaction.
3. Refuse live installation while the lifecycle contract is unapproved.

## Would Revise If

Revise when G-01 is approved, or by 2026-10-21 if this contract is mistaken for
a working installer in any candidate session.
